title: Inventory page
summary: Your scanned materials have their own page now, with search, filters and pages.

changes.text: Inventory page: everything your scans have added, with Clear All and the GOOD export. After a scan, the app takes you straight there.
Search your inventory, filter it by category and rarity, sort it by in-game order, quantity, rarity or name, and page through it.
An Inventory link in the top bar, between Home and Materials.
Inventory cards squash when you hover them, like the material cards.
The results list under the scanner; your scanned materials are on the Inventory page instead.
